title: Freeze generated result boundaries and make Unity mesh lifetime explicit
description: Resolve the mismatch between GeneratedCreatureData's documented immutable handoff and its mutable nested MeshExtractionResult/CreatureDefinition object graphs. Define which stage outputs are immutable after generation and enforce that boundary without hiding required editor operations. As part of the same boundary review, make MeshExtractionResult.ToUnityMesh resource ownership exception-safe so a partially constructed Unity Mesh cannot leak when SetVertices, SetTriangles, normals, or bounds calculation fails before CreatureMeshGenerator.Assemble establishes its current cleanup scope.

comments.author: ChatGPT
comments.body: Current-head audit 2026-09-12: GeneratedCreatureData documents itself as immutable, but MeshExtractionResult exposes public mutable Lists and Definition exposes a mutable cloned CreatureDefinition. ToUnityMesh creates a Unity Mesh before later calls that may throw, while CreatureMeshGenerator.Assemble starts its cleanup try only after ToUnityMesh returns. Make the stage-output contract explicit and close the mesh lifetime gap without coupling pure extraction to Unity ownership.
